complaints.title: Shankar Nagar mein Stree Light kharab hai
complaints.description: Ward 24 ke paas pichle 5 dino se streetlights band hain jisse raat mein aane-jaane mein pareshani hoti hai.

complaints.title: Civil Lines mein paani ki aniyamit aapoorti

complaints.title: Nehru Nagar chowk par bade gaddhe
complaints.description: Sadak par bade gaddhe ho gaye hain jiski wajah se digh-ghatnayein ho rahi hain.
